name: Manhattan Matinee Favorites 2026
information:
# Please read the [Favorites Competition Format](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/ManhattanMatineeFavorites2026#82071-favorites-competition-format-must-read) tab before registering. You are only able to register for a limited number of the events available at this competition.


## This competition will run in 3 groups. You will compete in one group and judge/scramble for the others. You MUST be present from 4:30pm until 8pm, otherwise you will not be allowed to compete.
